name: devices
description: A paired screen: its identity in one company and branch, configuration, credential hash and unlink/erasure state.
lifecycle: Created ACTIVE when a member claims an enrollment. Renamed, rotated and moved within the company with optimistic versions. Unlinking makes it REVOKED with erasure PENDING, irreversibly; the screen confirms erasure (CONFIRMED, credential hash deleted) or a member records a controlled reset (RESET_RECORDED). Rows are kept with the company; no runtime deletion.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the device; immutable (tenant key).
Branch the screen is assigned to within its company.
Enrollment the device was claimed from; a plain identifier because enrollments are purged.
Trimmed screen name shown to members.
Configured clockwise rotation in degrees: 0 and 180 horizontal, 90 and 270 vertical; one the screen reported as supported.
ACTIVE screens use every device operation; REVOKED screens can only learn they must clear and confirm it.
NONE while active; PENDING after unlink; CONFIRMED by the screen or RESET_RECORDED by a member.
SHA-256 of the screen's current credential.
columns.Null meaning: Erasure was confirmed, so the credential no longer authenticates.

columns.Meaning: SHA-256 of a rotated credential that replaces the current one on first use.
The screen's latest report of its application, model, display and supported rotations; a device statement, not a qualified profile.
Latest authenticated device request, written at most once per minute.
columns.Null meaning: The screen has not called since pairing.

columns.Meaning: PostgreSQL-clock instant the device was paired.
PostgreSQL-clock instant the device was unlinked.
Instant the erasure was confirmed by the screen or the reset was recorded.
Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful change.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change.
Explicit IANA time zone of the screen's local business time, set with devices.manage.
columns.Null meaning: The screen follows its branch's time zone.

constraints.Purpose: An active device always has a credential.
Exactly the active devices have no erasure state.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The device's branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A device belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, paired_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The pairing membership belongs to the same company.
A confirmed erasure leaves no credential hash.
The stored credential hash is a SHA-256 digest.
An erasure instant exists exactly for confirmed or recorded erasures.
Names are stored trimmed and nonempty.
A rotation names a different credential.
The stored rotated credential hash is a SHA-256 digest.
Unique device identity.
The report is a JSON object.
A revocation instant exists exactly for revoked devices.
Only active devices can have a pending credential rotation.
Rotation is a quarter turn.
An explicit time zone looks like an IANA zone name; the API validates it against the runtime's zone database.
Versions start at one.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX devices_company_branch_status_idx ON public.devices USING btree (company_id, branch_id, status)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a branch's devices and finds active devices before a branch is archived.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_company_id_id_key ON public.devices USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key for references to devices.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX devices_company_paired_idx ON public.devices USING btree (company_id, paired_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a company's devices newest pairing first with stable keyset pagination.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_credential_key ON public.devices USING btree (credential_hash)
constraints.Purpose: Finds a device by credential hash; credentials never collide.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_enrollment_key ON public.devices USING btree (enrollment_id)
constraints.Purpose: An enrollment creates at most one device and finds it when the player polls.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_next_credential_key ON public.devices USING btree (next_credential_hash)
constraints.Purpose: Finds a device by its rotated credential; credentials never collide.
